## Checklist

- [ ] Lint passes

- [ ] No secrets
- [ ] Data-license impact checked (license register, attribution, non-commercial sources)

## Review status

Approvals are labels plus a COMMENT review. Every bot is @bllbtnd, so GitHub
cannot accept an approving review on our own PR. A new commit removes
`reviewer-approved`, `qa-passed`, and `architect-approved`.

- [ ] `reviewer-approved`
- [ ] `qa-passed`
- [ ] `architect-approved`
- [ ] `changes-requested` is absent
- [ ] `ci-ok` is green
- [ ] `merge-gate` is green

The Architect squash-merges after those gates are green. Botond does not OK
each merge. Questions for Botond go through Boss.
